payload.title: closed pipe ending is smoke-proved, not tested
payload.body: Unit command-tree installs endOnClosedStdout once in packages/cli/src/cratylus.ts; 'project --verbose | head -1', '--help | head -1' and 'plan --help | head -1' were run by hand (exit 0, no EPIPE on stderr), but no permanent test spawns the built bin against a closed pipe, because packages/cli test builds the program in-process and the cli test task does not depend on its own build in turbo. The README-vs-help test also names commands and verbs only, not their flags.
